tools.name: explore_tree
tools.title: Explore a question
tools.description: Research a complex question by decomposing it into a sourced knowledge tree. Depth and breadth must each be between 1 and 4.

objective.description: The decision, task, or outcome this research should support.

audience.description: Who will consume or act on the findings.

scope.description: Specific dimensions that the research must cover.

constraints.description: Boundaries, assumptions, exclusions, or requirements to respect.

freshness.description: How recent the evidence should be, such as 'last 12 months'.

desired_output.description: How the user intends to apply the research, such as an executive recommendation or comparison.

tools.name: expand_node
tools.title: Expand a research branch
tools.description: Expand a leaf node in an existing ExploreTree research session.

tools.name: add_followup
tools.title: Add a research follow-up
tools.description: Add a focused follow-up question below a node in an existing ExploreTree research session.

tools.name: get_research_results
tools.title: Get research results
tools.description: Retrieve the current status and compact sourced findings for an existing ExploreTree research session. Use this before answering questions about completed research when the final artifact is not already present in model context.

session_id.description: The ExploreTree session identifier returned by explore_tree.

tools.name: get_node_media
tools.title: Load node media
tools.description: Load image and video references for an ExploreTree node.
